title: Role Composer: guided role creation with permission guardrails and simulation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a new 'Role Composer' UX in Console for RBAC v2 that guides admins through role creation, enforces permission guardrails, surfaces SSO/group mapping choices, and includes an interactive 'simulate user' pane that previews effective permissions and expected audit log entries. This ticket focuses on desktop Console flows (primary) and designs for the member assignment and role-review flow that ties into deployment/release controls. The composer should: 1) start from templates (read-only, infra-admin, billing-admin, custom), 2) allow fine-grained permission toggles grouped by product surface (API, Console, Dedicated, Private), 3) warn and require justification for high-privileged permissions, 4) include an optional approval/owner step for sensitive roles, 5) show real-time estimated audit log output when permissions are changed, and 6) provide a 'simulate as' mode to preview downstream effects (e.g., which console routes, models, and deployment actions will be allowed) and connect with existing SSO/SAML group sync mapping UI. Deliverables: wireframes for main composer, member assignment modal, compact roles list row (with indicators), high-privilege confirmation flow, and a short prototype demonstrating simulation and audit-log preview.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity wireframes for role composer main screen, member assignment modal, and role detail page are completed and reviewed by PM + Eng
Prototype demonstrates 'simulate as' showing effective permissions (at minimum: Console routes, API scopes, Dedicated actions) and a mock audit log preview that updates as permission toggles change
Guardrail rules implemented in design: mandatory justification for three or more high-priv permissions, inline warnings for risky combos, and a required owner/approver for 'admin-tier' roles
SSO/SAML group mapping flow shown as an integrated step with clear mapping preview and conflict diagnostics (e.g., group grant vs role grant)
Design tokens and spacing conform to Console design system and include accessibility notes (keyboard nav, color contrast, screen reader labels)
Design handoff package (Figma file, redlines, copy snippets) uploaded and linked; at least one engineering feasibility review conducted with runtime/serving and security engineers
UX flows include success and error states, and a short note on how actions emit audit log events (format examples) for the security team
